map.穗数法 亩产(kg) = 亩穗数(万穗) × 穗粒数 × 千粒重(g) ÷ 1: Ear-count method yield (kg/mu) = ears/mu (10k) x grains/ear x 1000-grain weight (g) / 1,000,000; quad method yield = quad weight x dry-matter rate x 666.67 / quad area; standard yield = yield x (100 - moisture) / (100 - 13)
map.两种测产法：① 穗数法按「亩穗数 × 穗粒数 × 千粒重」折算理论产量；② 样方: Two methods: 1) ear-count uses "ears/mu x grains/ear x 1000-grain weight" for theoretical yield; 2) quad method uses sampled harvested weight x dry-matter rate scaled to mu. Both then normalize by standard 13% moisture: standard yield = yield x (100 - actual moisture) / (100 - 13) so different-moisture yields are comparable. Total = standard yield x area, with yield grade reference.
map.理论产量(kg/亩) = 亩穗数(万) × 穗粒数 × 千粒重(g) × 10⁻: Theoretical yield (kg/mu) = ears/mu (10k) x grains/ear x 1000-grain weight (g) x 10⁻²

map.密度 4500 株/亩、单株穗数 1、穗粒数 520、千粒重 320 g。理论产: Density 4500 plants/mu, ears per plant 1, grains per ear 520, 1000-grain weight 320 g. Theoretical yield = 4500x520x320/(1000x1000) = 748.8 kg/mu. Survival 90%, harvest coefficient 0.85, expected actual ~ 748.8x0.9x0.85 ~ 573 kg/mu.
map.理论产量和实收差很多正常吗？: Is a big gap between theoretical and actual normal?
map.常见。理论产量按『理想单株』算，实际有空秆、秃尖、落粒、病虫折损。乘以保苗率与收: Common. Theoretical uses "ideal plant"; actual has barren stalks, tip abortion, shattering, pest loss. Multiply by survival and harvest coefficient (0.8-0.9) to approach actual.
